# Example of identifying pathway name
```{r find the exact pathway names}
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(pw_mia_strat))
unique(tax_df$pathway_name) %>%
    grep("heme", ., value = TRUE)
```

## Baseline vs week 2 in supragingival plaque
```{r extract rows beloning to pathway}
tax_phylo <- pw_mia_strat %>% 
  subset_samples(Sample == "Plaque" & 
                 Time_new %in% c("Baseline", "Week 2")) %>% 
  subset_taxa(pathway_name %in% c("L-N-delta--acetylornithine Bios.", "L-ornithine Bios. II", "SPWY. of putrescine Bios.", 
                                  "SPWY. of polyamine Bios. I", "heme b Bios. V (aerobic)", "heme b Bios. II (oxygen-independent)", 
                                  "CMP-3-deoxy-D-manno-octulosonate Bios.")) 

# Extract taxonomy
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(tax_phylo))
tax$Genus[is.na(tax$Genus) | tax$Genus %in% c("", "NA", "unclassified", "Unclassified", "g__")] <- "Unclassified"
tax$feature <- rownames(tax)

# Extract OTU
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(tax_phylo)) 
otu$feature <- rownames(otu)

df <- left_join(otu, tax, by = "feature")

otu_genus <- df %>%
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus)) %>%
  group_by(pathway_id, pathway_name, Genus, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop")

# Extract metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(tax_phylo))

meta <- structure(meta, class = "data.frame", row.names = rownames(meta))

meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)
```

```{r calculate species richness per sample}
richness_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("S_"), names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0) %>%   # only species that are present
  group_by(pathway_name, Superclass2, Time_new, Genus, Sample) %>%
  summarise(n_species = n_distinct(Species),.groups = "drop")

richness_long <- richness_long %>%
  mutate(Group = if_else(Genus == "Unclassified", "Unclassified","Classified"))

richness_legend_levels <- c(setdiff(levels(richness_long$Genus), "Unclassified"), "Unclassified")

richness_long <- richness_long %>%
  mutate(Genera = factor(Genus, levels = richness_legend_levels))
```

```{r}
richness_df <- richness_long %>%
  filter(Group == "Classified") %>%
  distinct(pathway_name, Superclass2, Sample, Time_new, Genus, n_species)

richness_p <- ggplot(richness_df, aes(x = Time_new, y = n_species)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6) + facet_nested(~ Sample + Superclass2 + pathway_name, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "Species richness", x = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

richness_p
```

```{r}
otu_long <- otu_genus %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("S_"), names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
  mutate(Genus = trimws(Genus), Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus), Genus = factor(Genus)) %>%
  group_by(pathway_name, Sample, Time_new, Genus, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

otu_long <- otu_long %>%
  mutate(Group = if_else(Genus == "Unclassified", "Unclassified","Classified"))

legend_levels <- c(setdiff(levels(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified"), "Unclassified")

otu_long <- otu_long %>%
  mutate(Genera = factor(Genus, levels = legend_levels))
```

```{r create color palette}
all_genus <- unique(as.character(otu_long$Genus))

other <- setdiff(all_genus, "Unclassified")

fill_colors <- c("Unclassified" = "#DF8F4499", setNames(viridis::viridis(length(setdiff(unique(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified")), option = "turbo"), setdiff(unique(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified")))
```

```{r}
baseline_week2_plaque_p <- ggplot(
  otu_long,
  aes(x = Time_new, y = Abundance, fill = Genera)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_nested(Group ~ Sample + Superclass2 + pathway_name, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, drop = FALSE) + 
  labs(x = "Time point", y = "Average genus contribution to pathway") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), 
        legend.position = "bottom") + guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE, nrow = 5))

baseline_week2_plaque_p
```

```{r}
baseline_week2_plaque_p <- richness_p/baseline_week2_plaque_p +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 4))

baseline_week2_plaque_p


ggsave("/Volumes/lnp524/PhD/Puplications/2025/Metagenomic_characterization/08_tax_contribution/08_plots/baseline_week2_plaque.png", plot = baseline_week2_plaque_p, dpi = 300, 
       units = "cm", width = 50, height = 30)
```

# Week 2 vs week 4 in saliva
```{r extract rows beloning to pathway}
tax_phylo <- pw_mia_strat %>% 
  subset_samples(Sample == "Saliva" & 
                 Time_new %in% c("Week 2", "Week 4")) %>% 
  subset_taxa(pathway_name %in% c("adenine and adenosine salvage III", "inosine-5'-phosphate Bios. I", 
                                  "inosine-5'-phosphate Bios. II", "inosine-5'-phosphate Bios. III", 
                                  "SPWY. of purine deoxyriboNucleos. Degrad.", "SPWY. of purine nucleotide salvage", 
                                  "5-aminoimidazole ribonucleotide Bios. I", "L-cysteine Bios. VI (from L-methionine)", 
                                  "L-lysine Bios. II", "L-methionine Bios. II", "L-tryptophan Bios.", 
                                  "SPWY. of L-isoleucine Bios. I", "SPWY. of L-phenylalanine Bios.", 
                                  "SPWY. of L-tryptophan Bios.", "SPWY. of L-tyrosine Bios."))

# Extract taxonomy
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(tax_phylo))
tax$Genus[is.na(tax$Genus) | tax$Genus %in% c("", "NA", "unclassified", "Unclassified", "g__")] <- "Unclassified"
tax$feature <- rownames(tax)
```

```{r}
                                  "L-lysine Bios. II" = "L-lysine Bios. II", 
                                  "L-methionine Bios. II" = "L-methionine Bios. II",

                                  "SPWY. of L-tryptophan Bios." = "SPWY. of \nL-tryptophan Bios.", 
                                  "SPWY. of L-tyrosine Bios." = "SPWY. of \nL-tyrosine Bios."), 
                             Superclass2 = c(
                                  "Nucleoside and Nucleotide Degrad." = "Nucleoside and \nNucleotide Degrad."))
```

```{r OTU}
    Genus = trimws(Genus),
    Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus),
    Genus = factor(Genus)
  ) %>%
  group_by(pathway_name, Sample, Time_new, Genus, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(
    Abundance = mean(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

otu_long <- otu_long %>%
  mutate(Group = if_else(Genus == "Unclassified", "Unclassified","Classified"))

legend_levels <- c(setdiff(levels(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified"),
                   "Unclassified")

otu_long <- otu_long %>%
  mutate(Genera = factor(Genus, levels = legend_levels))
```

```{r create color palette}
all_genus <- unique(as.character(otu_long$Genus))

other <- setdiff(all_genus, "Unclassified")

fill_colors <- c("Unclassified" = "#DF8F4499", setNames(viridis::viridis(length(setdiff(unique(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified")), option = "turbo"), setdiff(unique(otu_long$Genus), "Unclassified")))
```

```{r}
week2_week4_saliva_p <- ggplot(
  otu_long,
  aes(x = Time_new, y = Abundance, fill = Genera)) +
  geom_col(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  facet_nested(Group ~ Sample + Superclass2 + pathway_name, labeller = pathway_labeller, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, drop = FALSE) + 
  labs(x = "Time point", y = "Average genus contribution to pathway") +
  theme_bw() +

        legend.position = "bottom") + guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = FALSE, nrow = 5))
```

# Baseline vs week 4 in saliva
```{r extract rows beloning to pathway}
tax_phylo <- pw_mia_strat %>% 
  subset_samples(Sample == "Saliva" & 
                 Time_new %in% c("Baseline", "Week 4")) %>% 
  subset_taxa(pathway_name %in% c("ADP-L-glycero--beta--D-manno-heptose Bios.", "heme b Bios. I (aerobic)",
                                  "heme b Bios. II (oxygen-independent)", "biotin Bios. II", 
                                  "hexitol Ferm. to lactate, formate, ethanol and acetate", "glycogen Bios. I (from ADP-D-Glucose)", 
                                  "glycogen Degrad. II", "glucose and glucose-1-phosphate Degrad.", "mevalonate pathway I (eukaryotes and bacteria)"))

# Extract taxonomy
tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(tax_phylo))
tax$Genus[is.na(tax$Genus) | tax$Genus %in% c("", "NA", "unclassified", "Unclassified", "g__")] <- "Unclassified"
tax$feature <- rownames(tax)

# Extract OTU
otu <- as.data.frame(otu_table(tax_phylo)) 
otu$feature <- rownames(otu)

df <- left_join(otu, tax, by = "feature")

otu_genus <- df %>%
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus) | Genus == "", "Unclassified", Genus)) %>%
  group_by(pathway_id, pathway_name, Genus, Superclass2) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum), .groups = "drop")

# Extract metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(tax_phylo))

meta <- structure(
  meta,
  class = "data.frame",
  row.names = rownames(meta)
)

meta$SampleID <- rownames(meta)
```

```{r}
pathway_labeller <- labeller(pathway_name = c(
                                  "ADP-L-glycero--beta--D-manno-heptose Bios." = "ADP-L-glycero--beta--D-\nmanno-heptose Bios.", 
                                  "heme b Bios. I (aerobic)" = "heme b Bios. I (aerobic)",
                                  "heme b Bios. II (oxygen-independent)" = "heme b Bios. II \n(oxygen-independent)", 
                                  "biotin Bios. II" = "biotin Bios. II", 
                                  "hexitol Ferm. to lactate, formate, ethanol and acetate" = "hexitol Ferm. to lactate, \nformate, ethanol and acetate", 
                                  "glycogen Bios. I (from ADP-D-Glucose)" = "glycogen Bios. I \n(from ADP-D-Glucose)", 
                                  "glycogen Degrad. II" = "glycogen Degrad. II", 
                                  "glucose and glucose-1-phosphate Degrad." = "glucose and \nglucose-1-phosphate Degrad.", 
                                  "mevalonate pathway I (eukaryotes and bacteria)" = "mevalonate pathway I \n(eukaryotes and bacteria)"), 
                             Superclass2 = c(
                                  "Carb. Degrad.-Alcohol Degrad.-Ferm." = "Carb. Degrad.-Alcohol \nDegrad.-Ferm.", 
                                  "Carb. Degrad.-Polymeric Comp. Degrad." = "Carb. Degrad.-Polymeric \nComp. Degrad."))
```

```{r calculate species richness per sample}
richness_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("S_"), names_to = "SampleID", values_to = "Abundance") %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "SampleID") %>%
  filter(Abundance > 0) %>%   # only species that are present
  group_by(pathway_name, Superclass2, Time_new, Genus, Sample) %>%
  summarise(n_species = n_distinct(Species),.groups = "drop")

richness_long <- richness_long %>%
  mutate(Group = if_else(Genus == "Unclassified", "Unclassified","Classified"))

richness_legend_levels <- c(setdiff(levels(richness_long$Genus), "Unclassified"), "Unclassified")

richness_long <- richness_long %>%
  mutate(Genera = factor(Genus, levels = richness_legend_levels))
```

```{r}
richness_df <- richness_long %>%
  filter(Group == "Classified") %>%
  distinct(pathway_name, Superclass2, Sample, Time_new, Genus, n_species)

richness_p <- ggplot(richness_df, aes(x = Time_new, y = n_species)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6) + facet_nested(~ Sample + Superclass2 + pathway_name, labeller = pathway_labeller, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(y = "Species richness", x = NULL) +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

richness_p
```
